name: Exp_Ang_Zad_C_Tm_MMRec
summary: This Expert Advisor implements a multi-timeframe trading strategy based on the Ang_Zad_C indicator with time filtering and money management recommendations. It combines signal confirmation across different timeframes to generate trade entries, applies session/time filters to avoid unfavorable trading periods, and includes a money management recommendation module for position sizing guidance.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了基于Ang_Zad_C指标的多周期交易策略，结合时间过滤和资金管理推荐功能。它通过不同时间周期的信号确认来产生交易入场点，应用时段过滤避免不利交易时段，并包含资金管理推荐模块用于仓位 sizing 指导。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于Ang_Zad_C指标，这是一个自定义的技术指标，用于识别市场趋势方向和动量变化。入场条件要求多个时间周期的信号确认一致，例如短期和长期时间框架同时发出买入或卖出信号，从而提高交易的可靠性。出场条件可能包括指标反转信号、固定止损止盈或追踪止损机制。仓位管理采用资金管理推荐系统（MMRec），根据账户余额和风险参数动态调整交易手数。时间过滤模块（Tm）限制EA只在特定的交易时段内开仓，避免在市场流动性低或波动异常的时段进行交易。整体策略试图通过多周期确认降低虚假信号的影响，同时利用时间过滤提高交易质量。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Ang_Zad_C indicator, a custom technical indicator designed to identify market trend direction and momentum shifts. Entry conditions require signal confirmation consistency across multiple timeframes, for example when both short-term and long-term timeframes simultaneously generate buy or sell signals, thereby improving trade reliability. Exit conditions likely include indicator reversal signals, fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, or trailing stop mechanisms. Position sizing employs a money management recommendation system (MMRec) that dynamically adjusts trade lot sizes based on account balance and risk parameters. The time filtering module (Tm) restricts the EA from opening positions only during specific trading sessions, avoiding periods of low market liquidity or abnormal volatility. The overall strategy attempts to reduce the impact of false signals through multi-timeframe confirmation while improving trade quality via time-based filtering.

parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size (when MM is disabled)

pros: 多周期信号确认机制有效降低虚假信号干扰
时间过滤功能避免在低流动性或高波动时段交易
资金管理推荐模块提供合理的仓位 sizing 建议
策略逻辑相对清晰，参数可调性较强
结合趋势和动量分析，入场逻辑具有一定合理性
pros_en: Multi-timeframe signal confirmation effectively reduces false signal interference
Time filtering feature avoids trading during low liquidity or high volatility sessions
Money management recommendation module provides reasonable position sizing guidance
Strategy logic is relatively clear with good parameter adjustability
Combining trend and momentum analysis gives the entry logic some rationality
cons: 依赖自定义指标Ang_Zad_C，该指标的可获得性和可靠性存疑
多周期确认可能导致入场延迟，错过趋势初期最佳入场点
缺乏详细的回测数据支持策略有效性验证
时间过滤过于简单，仅基于小时级别，未考虑周末和节假日
资金管理推荐模块可能过于保守或激进，缺乏动态调整机制
cons_en: Reliance on the custom Ang_Zad_C indicator raises questions about its availability and reliability
Multi-timeframe confirmation may cause delayed entries, missing optimal early-trend entry points
Lack of detailed backtesting data to support strategy effectiveness verification
Time filtering is overly simplistic, based only on hourly levels without considering weekends and holidays
The money management recommendation module may be too conservative or aggressive, lacking dynamic adjustment mechanisms
improvements: 增加自适应时间周期选择机制，根据市场波动自动调整确认周期
引入动态止损止盈机制，基于ATR或市场波动性自动调整出场参数
improvements_en: Add an adaptive timeframe selection mechanism that automatically adjusts confirmation periods based on market volatility
Introduce dynamic stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms that automatically adjust exit parameters based on ATR or market volatility

risk_points: 多周期确认延迟可能导致在趋势末期入场，增加反转风险
自定义指标Ang_Zad_C的稳定性未经充分验证，可能在极端行情下失效
缺乏对异常点差和滑点的防护机制
risk_points_en: Multi-timeframe confirmation delay may cause entries at trend exhaustion, increasing reversal risk
The stability of the custom Ang_Zad_C indicator is not sufficiently verified and may fail during extreme market conditions
Lack of protection mechanisms against abnormal spreads and slippage
